verdict.rationale: Amazon SES is a cloud email service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an official SES MCP server. The probes show only an llms.txt file and markdown docs, which are AI-friendly documentation rather than an MCP server, and the SDK, SMTP and API access are developer building blocks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
